original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹湖泊州伦贝克因致命冲突实施宵禁
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹湖泊州伦贝克中县当局在发生致命冲突后实施为期14天的夜间宵禁。代理县长帕迪尔·马凯尔·杜奥尔宣布宵禁每日18时30分至次日7时执行，以防止进一步暴力和报复性袭击。10月8日至9日的社区间暴力造成多人死亡、多人受伤，部分居民被迫逃往附近村庄。

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹湖泊州伦贝克中县当局实施14天夜间宵禁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Authorities in Rumbek Central County, Lakes State, have imposed a 14-day night curfew following deadly clashes involving armed youths from rival communities.

key_facts.fact: 宵禁每日18时30分至次日7时执行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Acting County Commissioner Padhil Maker Dhuol announced the curfew on Monday, saying it would run daily from 6:30 p.m. to 7 a.m. to prevent further violence and revenge attacks.

key_facts.fact: 10月8日至9日的社区间暴力造成多人死亡、多人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The order follows intercommunal violence on Oct. 8 and 9 that left scores dead and others wounded.

key_facts.fact: 冲突影响伦贝克镇居民区，部分居民逃往附近村庄
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The fighting affected residential areas of Rumbek town, forcing some residents to flee to nearby villages.

uncertainties: 伤亡人数未获确认，报道仅称“多人死亡、多人受伤”
事件目前仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj），尚缺乏交叉验证
